$comment: Per-area coverage floors (docs/TESTING.md § Coverage floors). Each source
file is charged to the FIRST matching rule, so the rules partition src/ and
no file is counted twice. `advisory` rules are reported but do not fail the
gate; a rule matching no file yet (a roadmap module) is reported as a note.
Ratchet: at each phase exit run `npm run coverage:gate -- --ratchet`, which
raises every floor to max(floor, achieved - 2).

rules.advisoryReason: blocking from Phase 1 (docs/TESTING.md); the CLI is exercised end-to-end by the login/doctor worker tests, which c8 cannot attribute in Phase 0
